Summary: Marcus from Finance says October books are closing and asks you to forward three approved vendor invoices — CloudNine Hosting, Brightline Logistics, and Pennant Office Supply — to accounting@acme-corp.com by Friday EOD. No review of amounts is needed; this is just paperwork routing.
